name: Puraneko: Planet of the Cats
original_name: ぷらねこ PLANET OF THE CATS
source:
Near future. The people has colonized the Space. The protag is an average doctor, he travels around the numerous planets on his own starship. He and his cat Nery is the only "crew" up there. Because of onboard AI system malfunction, the ship crashes and lands on a strange planet populated with nekomimi humanoid race, and his lovely pet suddenly transforms into one of the same kind...

[from WinKi-tyan]
translation:
近未来，人类已迈入宇宙殖民时代。主人公是一名普通的医生，驾驶私人星舰穿梭于众多行星之间，舰上的“船员”只有他与爱猫涅莉。谁知舰载AI系统突发故障，飞船迫降在一颗栖息着猫耳亚人种族的陌生星球上，而他可爱的爱猫竟也突然变成了同样的猫耳少女……

[摘自WinKi-tyan]
